voices.speaker: mira
voices.text: That came from upstairs. Did everyone hear it?
voices.direction: Immediate, attentive. Look toward the staircase.

voices.speaker: elias
voices.text: Yes. All four. Victor's room?
voices.direction: Genuine uncertainty. Keep the question ordinary and unweighted.

voices.speaker: ada
voices.text: Stay here. I'll check on him.
voices.direction: Practical decision, with unease contained.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: That sounded less like a request.
voices.direction: A quiet aside before following, no broad punchline.
voices.step11: Restored after s7_04 (Step 10 audit K2; Step 11 audio contract change).

voices.speaker: ada
voices.text: Victor? It's Ada. Is everything all right?
voices.direction: Call through an ordinary closed door, not a horror whisper.

voices.speaker: ada
voices.text: No answer. The key lock turns freely. It is the separate night latch. We usually keep its hold-back on.
voices.direction: Practical concern. Identify the separate night latch without solving the staged-room assumption.

voices.speaker: mira
voices.text: He's not answering any of us. We shouldn't just leave him in there.
voices.direction: Concern replaces impatience.

voices.speaker: elias
voices.text: The door's secured. Keep clear of the frame. I'll help.
voices.direction: Practical, reassuring, no special expertise about the lock.

voices.speaker: ada
voices.text: Victor, we're coming in.
voices.direction: Firm warning, then a pause.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: Victor... He isn't breathing.
voices.direction: Low, plain, stunned. No noir flourish.

voices.speaker: elias
voices.text: We need a doctor.
voices.direction: Contained shock and urgent concern. No suspicious pause.

voices.speaker: mira
voices.text: If those knocks were Victor, he was alive at nine-fourteen. That was only a few minutes ago.
voices.direction: An assumption forming, not an established fact.

voices.speaker: ada
voices.text: The road is blocked. I'll keep trying the telephone, but help won't reach us straightaway in this storm.
voices.direction: Practical facts, restrained distress. No new emergency details.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: The glass is cracked. A mechanical watch. It stopped at nine-oh-eight.
voices.direction: Careful observation; make the time clear.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: Tell me about the rhythm. What did you hear?
voices.direction: Open question, no accusation.

voices.speaker: mira
voices.text: Three knocks, close together. Then a pause. The last one made me look up again. I couldn't tell you who made them.
voices.direction: Precise eyewitness recall, no certainty beyond hearing.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: Did you know Victor before tonight?
voices.direction: Neutral, concise.

voices.speaker: mira
voices.text: I knew of his work. That isn't quite the same as knowing him. Why?
voices.direction: A little defensive, not overtly guilty.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: When you reached the door, what did you find?
voices.direction: Ask about observation, not lock mechanics.

voices.speaker: ada
voices.text: It was shut. I called his name, tried the handle, then waited for an answer. There wasn't one.
voices.direction: Clear sequence; no bolt, key or staging explanation.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: You recognised the four knocks?
voices.direction: Curious without treating folklore as proof.

voices.speaker: ada
voices.text: A family saying. Three knocks mean someone's at the door. Four means the house remembers. It's a saying, Aren.
voices.direction: Matter of fact, not spooky exposition or a supernatural confirmation.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: You heard all four as well?
voices.direction: Same open questioning tone as with the others.

voices.speaker: elias
voices.text: With you, downstairs. I looked up after the first. Ada was already listening. I heard the same thing you did.
voices.direction: Sincere, measured recall. No sinister emphasis on downstairs.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: His case stays at his side. He seems to be listening carefully.
voices.direction: Neutral visual observation, without implying guilt.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: I had asked for a dry room. The rain appeared to have followed me in to negotiate.
voices.direction: Understated internal aside.

voices.speaker: ada
voices.text: Welcome to Cedar House. Ada Moss. Leave the wet things by the door; this is still a guesthouse, not a pond.
voices.direction: Practical warmth.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: Aren Vale. Just passing through.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: ada
voices.text: My family has kept this place for years. Find a seat. Dinner can survive one more guest.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: mira
voices.text: Mira Senn. Writer. Local history, buildings, the people who own them.
voices.direction: Brisk, plausible cover.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: Light holiday reading.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: elias
voices.text: Elias Brann. Structural engineer. The loose stair tread is marked. Use the other side.
voices.direction: Ordinary helpfulness. No foreshadowing.

voices.speaker: mira
voices.text: He fixed the sign before anyone fell over it.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: victor
voices.text: Ada. Victor Soren. I trust my room is ready. The road has been quite unreasonable.
voices.direction: Polished social confidence, not a villain voice.

voices.speaker: ada
voices.text: Your room is ready. The road makes its own arrangements.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: victor
voices.text: Good. We should finish our business while I am here.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: Business? I thought everyone came here for the view.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: victor
voices.text: A view is an asset. So is this property, if sentiment does not get in the way.
voices.direction: Casually patronising.

voices.speaker: ada
voices.text: It was an enquiry about a rescue, not demolition. Cedar House is not for sale.
voices.direction: Firm refusal, financially pressured but capable.

voices.speaker: victor
voices.text: Your creditors may be less sentimental about the distinction.
voices.direction: Controlled pressure.

voices.speaker: mira
voices.text: Would the buyer be your company, or one of its intermediaries?
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: victor
voices.text: An unusually specific interest in local history.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: ada
voices.text: Three knocks mean someone's at the door. Four means the house remembers.
voices.direction: Matter of fact; family saying, not mystical exposition.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: I will try to be forgettable.
voices.direction: One quiet aside, then leave the joke behind.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: Were you upstairs before we found him?
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: mira
voices.text: No. I was downstairs. I barely knew the man.
voices.direction: A plausible lie, not a theatrical tell.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: A rust thread on his desk. A fresh snag in your scarf.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: mira
voices.text: I searched his room. Eight twenty-nine to eight thirty-four, while he was downstairs on the telephone. The door was open.
voices.direction: Admission under pressure, then regain composure.

voices.speaker: mira
voices.text: I’m investigating his redevelopment network. Cedar House is next. I took a Kaveri Heights photocopy. I didn’t know Elias.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: A theft and a lie. Not yet a murder.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: mira
voices.text: Ada saw me return. I stayed by the telephone with her until Elias came down.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: mira
voices.text: You have my page and my account. I should have given you both the first time.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: You saw Mira return at eight thirty-four?
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: ada
voices.text: Eight thirty-four. I checked the clock. She stayed beside me. Victor went upstairs at eight thirty-seven. Elias followed at eight fifty-one.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: ada
voices.text: Elias returned at nine thirteen. Mira hadn’t left me. Then the knocks.
voices.direction: Clear witness facts, not an accusation.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: You had agreed terms?
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: ada
voices.text: I had agreed draft terms. The bills were winning. Then I saw what they would pull down.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: ada
voices.text: I refused his demolition proposal. Then I stayed downstairs, calling about the road. Mira was with me.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: ada
voices.text: I called it an enquiry out of shame. That is all I concealed.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: This letter to Victor. Dev Brann signed it.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: elias
voices.text: My father. He signed the revised certificates at Kaveri Heights. He should not have.
voices.direction: Controlled, personal; not sinister.

voices.speaker: elias
voices.text: His records show cheaper materials and buried warnings. Six people died. His signature became the whole public story.
voices.direction: Serious. No comic beat.

voices.speaker: elias
voices.text: His career and reputation were gone. Years later, his appeal unresolved, he died by suicide.
voices.direction: Plain, restrained. No melodrama or musical flourish.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: The records do not excuse his signature. They show who else was responsible.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: elias
voices.text: That is what I wanted Victor to acknowledge.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: Your recorder. Its empty cassette sleeve is in your case.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: elias
voices.text: To record his admission. I went up at eight fifty-one. Victor let me in at eight fifty-three. I came downstairs at nine thirteen.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: This fragment fits the torn sheet in your case. Its edge has the same dark wiping streak as the bookend.
voices.direction: Ordinary visible comparison, not laboratory certainty.

voices.speaker: elias
voices.text: He grabbed the papers. The letter tore. I took the tape when I left. He was still standing.
voices.direction: He adjusts his spectacles once; hold composure.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: Elias. Your torn letter. Your recorder, without its tape. The wiping streak leads back to your case.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: You confronted Victor over Dev Brann and Kaveri Heights. Then used the brass bookend. Twice.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: The damaged watch marks the first disturbance. You place yourself there until just before nine thirteen.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: You released the night latch, left, and pulled the door shut. A caught latch does not put anyone inside. Nor do the knocks.
voices.direction: Refer to the player-demonstrated spring night latch; calm, exact accusation.

voices.speaker: elias
voices.text: The first hit wasn't supposed to happen.
voices.direction: Locked wording. Quiet, struggling to speak.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: And the second?
voices.direction: Locked wording. Ask plainly. Leave silence afterwards.

voices.speaker: elias
voices.text: He moved. I saw him move. I could have called for help. I chose to hit him again.
voices.direction: The silence has already held. No excuse, no triumph.

voices.speaker: elias
voices.text: He said my father signed. He was right. Then he said the rest did not matter, and that he could finish my career too.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: elias
voices.text: I wanted his admission on tape. Instead I cleaned the bookend, gathered the papers, took the cassette, released the hold-back and pulled the door shut behind me.
voices.direction: A plain admission of the demonstrated latch action, with no new trick.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: Your father compromised. Victor buried a wider crime. Neither gave you the right to kill him.
voices.direction: Natural, concise delivery. Let the other person finish.

voices.speaker: elias
voices.text: I didn't knock.
voices.direction: Locked wording. No sinister emphasis.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: I know.
voices.direction: Locked wording. Quiet certainty.

voices.speaker: ada
voices.text: Help is on its way. The room is sealed. Leave it until they arrive.
voices.direction: Near dawn. Exhausted, practical.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: By dawn, we had an answer for the death. I went upstairs to collect my things.
voices.direction: Internal, spent, no joke or promise of a sequel.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: Cedar House. Before the rains close the road. There is something you should see.
voices.direction: Understated Indian English. Allow the image and the other person room to register.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: No signature. An address, and a remarkable confidence in my curiosity.
voices.direction: Understated Indian English. Allow the image and the other person room to register.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: I had been passing through. Apparently, I was expected.
voices.direction: Understated Indian English. Allow the image and the other person room to register.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: The windows looked warm. That was enough of an answer for now.
voices.direction: Understated Indian English. Allow the image and the other person room to register.

voices.speaker: ada
voices.text: Please. Downstairs, both of you. Aren, see what you can without moving him.
voices.direction: Understated Indian English. Allow the image and the other person room to register.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: Nine-oh-eight. Six minutes before we heard the knocks.
voices.direction: Understated Indian English. Allow the image and the other person room to register.

voices.speaker: mira
voices.text: Outside. Just under the roof. I would rather say this without an audience.
voices.direction: Understated Indian English. Allow the image and the other person room to register.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: Then the knocks prove nothing about whether he was alive.
voices.direction: Understated Indian English. Allow the image and the other person room to register.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: The search came first. Ada places her downstairs when it matters.
voices.direction: Understated Indian English. Allow the image and the other person room to register.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: A confrontation was planned. The killing is another question.
voices.direction: Understated Indian English. Allow the image and the other person room to register.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: Downstairs. We need to put the whole evening together.
voices.direction: Understated Indian English. Allow the image and the other person room to register.

voices.speaker: ada
voices.text: The lower road is blocked. I will keep trying the telephone.
voices.direction: Practical household update. No dread or suspicious emphasis on anyone leaving.

voices.speaker: aren
voices.text: The spring catches when the door closes. Release the hold-back, step outside, pull it shut. No one needs to stay inside.
voices.direction: Explain the demonstrated action simply, with a small pause before the final sentence.

voices.speaker: victor
voices.text: Dev signed. Responsibility does not disappear because—
voices.direction: A fragment of an argument, cut off mid-thought. Restrained impatience; no ghost voice.

voices.speaker: victor
voices.text: Is the downstairs telephone working?
voices.direction: Ordinary practical question, heard from downstairs. No menace.
